name: profile-realitykit-apps
description: Profile and optimize RealityKit apps with unified logging, signposts, Instruments traces, and device-first performance evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Measure, diagnose, and verify RealityKit performance
interface.longDescription: Evidence-driven RealityKit diagnostics for Apple platforms: reproducible performance investigations, unified logging and OSSignposter instrumentation, RealityKit Trace, xctrace capability discovery, CPU and ECS analysis, frame and GPU analysis, memory and asset-lifetime analysis, physical-device validation, and before-and-after verification. Use alongside Build visionOS 27 apps for build and launch plumbing, Build with RealityKit for implementation fixes, and Build with Reality Composer Pro 3 for authored asset and graph corrections.
defaultPrompt: Create a reproducible RealityKit performance investigation and capture the smallest useful trace.
Correlate privacy-safe Logger and OSSignposter evidence with RealityKit Trace.
Compare matched device captures and verify whether an optimization improved the measured bottleneck.
